scope: same-equation 600 m moving-child versus oversized stationary Nimbus reference with inherited v8 thresholds, geometry, aperture, containment movement, orthogonal reserve, and a no-mutation receding trusted-face state

receding_trusted_face_amendment.eligibility: one or more inner-margin faces remain outside the immutable relaxation zone and no breached face is approaching by either selected motion or signed face motion

limitations: All numerical thresholds, geometry, aperture, measurement cadence, movement caps, and v10 orthogonal containment-reserve rules are inherited from the immutable v8 policy chain.
No comparison metric from the invalid v8 candidate was inspected or used to alter a threshold.
The receding trusted-face disposition performs no movement and applies only while every breached face remains outside relaxation and none is approaching by either authoritative motion source.

Any current relaxation-zone entry remains unrecoverable, and ambiguity, topology, parent containment, finite evidence, approaching-breach relocation, and fail-closed trusted-interior checks remain unchanged.
A pass remains a bounded same-equation fixed-aperture comparison and does not enable public moving_nest selection or broaden supported physics/backend combinations.
